ocl:
context Customer
inv: (self.address <> null) and (self.fullName <> '' and self.fullName.size() > 0)

context Customer
inv: (self.cards->any(x | x.limit <= 50) <> null) and (self.address <> null)

context Branch
inv: (self.customers->collect(x | x.customerId)->notEmpty()) and (self.city <> null)

context Loan
inv: (if self.principal > self.interestRate then self.principal else self.interestRate endif > 45) and (self.customer.oclIsTypeOf(Customer))

context CheckingAccount
inv: self.overdraftLimit >= 19 and self.overdraftLimit <= 31

context Account
inv: self.transactions->size() >= 1 and self.transactions->size() <= 2

context Address
inv: self.city <> null and self.line1 <> null

context Address
inv: self.country <> null implies self.line1 <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null and self.city <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null implies self.country <> null

context Account
inv: ((self.transactions->one(x | x.amount > 10)) and (self.balance >= 0)) and (self.customer.branch.city <> '')

context Address
inv: (not(self.city <> null and self.line1 <> null)) and (not(not(self.city <> null and self.line1 <> null)))

context Address
inv: (self.city <> null implies self.line1 <> null) and (not(self.city <> null implies self.line1 <> null))

context Loan
inv: ((self.principal > 0) and (if self.interestRate > self.principal then self.interestRate else self.principal endif >= 16)) and (self.principal < -5)

context AccountTransaction
inv: (self.type <> null) and (not(self.type <> null))

context Employee
inv: (((self.branch.bank.swiftCode <> '') and (self.branch.oclIsTypeOf(Branch))) and (self.name.toLowerCase() = 'test')) and (not(((self.branch.bank.swiftCode <> '') and (self.branch.oclIsTypeOf(Branch))) and (self.name.toLowerCase() = 'test')))

context Branch
inv: ((self.city <> '') and (self.employees->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (self.employees->exists(v | not(v.name <> '')))

context Customer
inv: (self.loans->exists(x | x.principal >= 1)) and (not(self.loans->exists(x | x.principal >= 1)))

context Payment
inv: (((self.transaction.payment.isConfirmed <> true) and (self.isConfirmed)) and (self.method.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not(((self.transaction.payment.isConfirmed <> true) and (self.isConfirmed)) and (self.method.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Address
inv: (self.city <> self.line1) and (not(self.city <> self.line1))

context Address
inv: ((self.line1 <> null) = (self.country <> null)) and (not((self.line1 <> null) = (self.country <> null)))

context Account
inv: ((self.transactions->size() <= 3) and (self.balance >= 74 and self.balance <= 94)) and (self.transactions->size() > 3)
